## apidiff-change-carries-no-location  (gotcha, verified)
golang.org/x/exp/apidiff's Change is only {Message string; Compatible bool} — no package path, no token.Pos — so a caller wanting a source line has to parse the `<name>: <what happened>` message text itself and resolve it against a loaded *types.Package; there is no structured, lower-level API.

- source/cli/internal/apisurface/apisurface.go

## cargo-deny-default-config-rejects-every-license  (gotcha, verified)
cargo-deny's default config (no deny.toml present) rejects every license, MIT included, so a crate with no deny.toml fails `check licenses` regardless of how it is actually licensed.

- source/cli/internal/rust/deny.go
- source/cli/internal/rust/testdata/deny-clean.ndjson

## cargo-deny-exit-status-is-a-bitmask  (gotcha, verified)
cargo-deny's exit status is a bitmask of which of the run checks failed (licenses vs bans, e.g. 4 vs 2 vs 6), not a plain 0/1 — a verdict check must not narrow to `== 1`.

- source/cli/internal/rust/deny.go
- source/cli/internal/rust/testdata/README.md

## code-review-manifest-omits-two-escalation-signals  (rationale, verified)
this repo's agtk code-review manifest deliberately drops the fix-revert and referencing_files escalation signals — both refuse outright on an ordinary multi-file, mixed-language diff, and a manifest present at all turns that refusal into a hard block rather than a silent skip.

## componentrows-needs-an-unconditional-row-per-gate  (invariant, verified)
a new per-component gate row must be emitted unconditionally by every shard, even when the gate flag wasn't passed, because componentRows's fold expects exactly one row per label per declared component and reads zero as a dead shard.

## exclusion-scope-is-a-funcdecl-or-a-mutant-span-never-a-symbol  (invariant, verified)
Three exclusion-scope resolvers exist — go/ast FuncDecl (coverage/CRAP, Go), a tree-sitter analogue (coverage/CRAP, Rust/TypeScript), and innermost-containing mutant span (mutation, all languages, picks only the shortest-replaced-text mutant on a line) — none resolves a symbol.

## go-list-m-all-names-modules-with-no-directory  (gotcha, verified)

## hitmemorylimit-ratio-threshold  (invariant, verified)
executil.Result.HitMemoryLimit() tells a memory-bound kill from an unrelated failure by peak/limit >= 1/3 (MaxRSS*3 >= MemoryLimit), an empirically-derived fraction that assumes mutation's own 4x-baseline ceiling and 2GiB floor — it does not generalize to a much smaller --memory override.

- source/cli/internal/executil/executil.go
- source/cli/internal/stages/mutation/budget.go

## mutation-memory-bound-is-rlimit-data  (dead-end, verified)
lydite mutation bounds a mutant's suite memory with RLIMIT_DATA applied post-Start (via Prlimit on the child pid) — RLIMIT_AS, GOMEMLIMIT and a cgroup v2 scope were all measured and rejected, and Darwin has no working equivalent at all.
